description: This Java class 'EntityTagMatcher' provides functionality to create and compare entity tags, including handling of wildcards (asterisks), for use in HTTP-like entity tag matching logic within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcher
classes.description: A final immutable class that matches entity tags, supporting wildcard '*' matching and comparison operations.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates an EntityTagMatcher from a string, returning a singleton instance for the asterisk.

methods.name: isAsterisk
methods.description: Checks if a given string or CharSequence is the asterisk wildcard.

methods.name: asterisk
methods.description: Returns the singleton EntityTagMatcher instance representing the asterisk wildcard.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid entity tag matcher, either an asterisk or a valid EntityTag.

methods.name: strongMatch
methods.description: Performs a strong comparison match between this EntityTagMatcher and a given EntityTag.

methods.name: weakMatch
methods.description: Performs a weak comparison match between this EntityTagMatcher and a given EntityTag.

methods.name: isAsterisk
methods.description: Indicates whether this EntityTagMatcher is the asterisk wildcard.
